title: Memory / Canon shell (approved-only empty states)
goal: Add a read-only Memory / Canon shell for approved-only project knowledge categories, showing safe empty states and clear candidate/canon boundaries without adding apply-promotion, approved-memory mutation, extraction, generated summaries, model calls, semantic search, or browser/manual validation.
why_now: PHASE7-IMPL-008 completed the frontend-transient OMI-guided staged creation shell. The workspace can now expose the next approved-memory/canon area as a read-only shell before any apply-promotion or durable memory mutation exists.

include: Approved-only category cards or tabs for characters, locations/settings, timeline, plot threads, continuity/consistency, open questions, relationships, organizations/groups, and objects/items.
Safe empty states when no approved records exist.
Clear labels that OMI candidates, approved-but-not-applied candidates, and promotion records are not canon.
Frontend workspace integration as a separate memory-canon workspace view.

Source-level tests for no candidate-as-canon, no apply-promotion, no memory/canon mutation, no extraction, no generated summaries, no model calls, no Story Check auto-runs, and no editor contamination.
exclude: Apply-promotion, promotion execution, memory/canon mutation, approved-truth mutation.
Generated prose, AI-written story content, summaries, extraction, semantic search, Story Check auto-runs, Dramatica analysis, model calls, Ollama calls.
Training data, JSONL data, dataset artifacts, browser/manual validation.
Metadata editing UI, note/material create/import/upload UI, category detail editing.

quality_notes: T001-T007 completed with source-level and regression coverage.
Read-only Memory / Canon shell delivered with approved-only empty states and App/Nav integration.
No backend approved-memory routes/helpers, frontend approved-memory API helpers, apply-promotion, memory/canon mutation, or browser/manual validation were added.
